description: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4 (PS2 NTSC-U, via PCSX2)
long: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4 is Atlus' 2008 PlayStation 2 role-playing game set in the rural town of Inaba, where a group of high-school students investigate a string of murders linked to a world inside the television. Days are split between a social-simulation half of school, part-time jobs and Social Links that strengthen the party's Personas, and a dungeon-crawling half of turn-based battles that exploit enemy weaknesses through the One More and All-Out Attack system. This is the original PS2 release, not the later Persona 4 Golden port, and it runs via the PCSX2 emulator.
